title: Workspace ONE to Microsoft Intune Migration Program
author_notes: Effort tier: T5 (enterprise multi-platform migration program across Windows/iOS/Android/macOS: assessment, coexistence, cutover, decommission; many technologies, org-wide, high risk).
hook: Move your whole fleet from Workspace ONE to Microsoft Intune — without losing a device or an app
problem: Migrating an enterprise off VMware Workspace ONE to Microsoft Intune is one of the highest-risk endpoint projects there is: thousands of enrolled Windows, iOS, Android, and Mac devices, hundreds of apps and profiles, and zero tolerance for a user losing email or access mid-day. Done ad hoc it stalls in finger-pointing between teams. This solution is the end-to-end Workspace ONE to Intune migration program — assessment and wave planning, identity and enrollment readiness, app and policy rebuild, coexistence, ringed cutover per platform, and clean Workspace ONE decommission — as one repeatable, documented operating model.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the migration model end to end, the per-platform approach (Windows, iOS/iPadOS, Android, macOS), coexistence vs. cutover, how identity/enrollment/apps/policies move, and the program operating model (roles, waves, KPIs).

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune licensing, Entra ID, Workspace ONE admin/export access, per-platform enrollment prerequisites, device/app inventory, executive sponsorship, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: assess and inventory the Workspace ONE estate, plan waves, stand up Intune enrollment and identity, rebuild apps and policies, run coexistence, cut over by ring/platform, validate, decommission Workspace ONE, then expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — migration-readiness discovery, per-device migration/enrollment validation, a program-wide migration status and parity report, safe remediation of failed migrations, and a wave/ring group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: The end-to-end Workspace ONE to Microsoft Intune migration program — assessment, wave planning, identity/enrollment readiness, app and policy rebuild, coexistence, ringed cutover per platform, and clean Workspace ONE decommission. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
